Credits & Licensing

Card data

Scryfall supplies the current bulk card and ruling data and set metadata. See the Scryfall API documentation for its usage terms.

EDHREC supplies the Commander popularity ranks included in Scryfall card records.

MTGJSON supplied data used by the original build via MTGJSON-slim.
